decisions_made: Chose the AIController seam (user direction): LLM issues semantic commands, UE AIController does MoveToLocation nav, CMC owns character physics.
Added a dedicated /api/avatar/command endpoint rather than overloading /api/avatar/action (which stays the low-level Learning-Agents-style action space).
Kept the LLM client dependency-light (stdlib only) and provider-agnostic by env config — satisfies the no-LLM-provider-lock-in guardrail.
Treat the UE HttpServer's non-standard 'HTTP/1.1 0' status line as success in the Python client (pre-existing server quirk, shared by all UE endpoints).
